chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from him that he said:
Then let them purchase from the general people, so long as he is not a Naṣibī.

key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, the named transmitter in the sanad
key_terms.عُرْضِ النَّاسِ: the general people; the broader public from whom purchase may be made
key_terms.فَلْيَشْتَرُوا: then let them purchase; an instruction permitting buying
key_terms.نَاصِبِيّاً: a Naṣibī; one who harbors enmity toward the Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy from the general public according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal directive permitting purchase from the general public with one stated exclusion: a Naṣibī. In context, it concerns transactional permissibility and draws a boundary based on religious hostility toward the Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them.
